verdict.rationale: Fern's first-party docs say Versions add a reader-facing dropdown for multiple releases. Each version can carry its own tabs, sections, pages, and API references, with content shared across versions, which covers publishing per-version docs and letting readers switch versions on the site. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the version switcher, and evidence of a separate per-product (not just per-version) selector.

support.subject: As a developer, I publish versioned documentation per product or API version, and readers switch versions from the site

citations.quote: Versions add a dropdown to your docs for multiple releases of the same content. Each version can contain its own tabs, sections, pages, and API references, and versions can share content.
